title: protobuf-bounds-auditor: Static Security Analyzer for Protocol Buffers (.proto) Schemas
description: Zero-dependency static security analyzer for Protocol Buffers (.proto) schemas detecting unbounded repeated sub-messages (CWE-1284), unvalidated IEEE-754 float/double wire fields (CWE-20), and untrusted allocation lengths (CWE-400), with SARIF v2.1.0 export and DEFINE_PROTO_FUZZER harness generation.
